001package org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator;
002
003import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Propagator;
004import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.PropagatorPriority;
005import org.chocosolver.solver.exception.ContradictionException;
006import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.IntVar;
007import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.SetVar;
008import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.Variable;
009import org.chocosolver.util.ESat;
010import org.chocosolver.util.objects.setDataStructures.ISetIterator;
011
012/**
013 *
014 * @author jimmy
015 */
016public class PropIntMemberSetDefault extends Propagator<Variable> {
017
018    private final IntVar element;
019    private final SetVar set;
020    private final IntVar setCard;
021    private final int defaultValue;
022
023    public PropIntMemberSetDefault(IntVar element, SetVar set, IntVar setCard, int support) {
024        super(new Variable[]{set, element, setCard}, PropagatorPriority.BINARY, false);
025        this.element = element;
026        this.set = set;
027        this.setCard = setCard;
028        this.defaultValue = support;
029    }
030
031    @Override
032    public void propagate(int evtmask) throws ContradictionException {
033        if (!PropUtil.isDomIntersectKer(element, set)) {
034            if (setCard.getLB() > 0 || !element.contains(defaultValue)) {
035                setCard.updateLowerBound(set.getLB().size() + 1, this);
036            }
037            if (setCard.getUB() == set.getLB().size() + 1
038                    && !PropUtil.isDomIntersectKer(element, set)) {
039                // set can take only one more value, and currently does not intersect element.
040                ISetIterator iter = set.getUB().iterator();
041                while (iter.hasNext()) {
042                    int i = iter.nextInt();
043                    if (!set.getLB().contains(i) && !element.contains(i)) {
044                        set.remove(i, this);
045                    }
046                }
047            }
048        }
049        if (setCard.getLB() > 0 || !element.contains(defaultValue)) {
050            PropUtil.domSubsetEnv(element, set, this);
051            if (element.isInstantiated()) {
052                set.force(element.getValue(), this);
053                setPassive();
054            }
055        } else if (setCard.getUB() == 0 || !PropUtil.isDomIntersectEnv(element, set)) {
056            element.instantiateTo(defaultValue, this);
057            setCard.instantiateTo(0, this);
058        } else {
059            if (set.getUB().contains(defaultValue)) {
060                PropUtil.domSubsetEnv(element, set, this);
061            } else {
062                int ub = element.getUB();
063                for (int i = element.getLB(); i <= ub; i = element.nextValue(i)) {
064                    if (i != defaultValue && !set.getUB().contains(i)) {
065                        element.removeValue(i, this);
066                    }
067                }
068            }
069        }
070    }
071
072    @Override
073    public ESat isEntailed() {
074        if (setCard.getLB() > 0 || !element.contains(defaultValue)) {
075            if (!PropUtil.isDomIntersectEnv(element, set)) {
076                return ESat.FALSE;
077            }
078            if (PropUtil.isDomSubsetKer(element, set)) {
079                return ESat.TRUE;
080            }
081            return ESat.UNDEFINED;
082        } else if (setCard.getUB() == 0) {
083            return element.contains(defaultValue)
084                    ? (element.isInstantiated() ? ESat.TRUE : ESat.UNDEFINED)
085                    : ESat.FALSE;
086        } else if (element.isInstantiatedTo(defaultValue)
087                && setCard.getDomainSize() == 2
088                && set.getUB().contains(defaultValue)
089                && set.getUB().size() == setCard.getUB()) {
090            assert setCard.getLB() == 0;
091            return ESat.TRUE;
092        }
093        return ESat.UNDEFINED;
094    }
095
096    @Override
097    public String toString() {
098        return element + " in " + set + " with " + setCard + " or else is " + defaultValue;
099    }
100}
